mapping.clock_domain_requirement: Both processes on same continuously awake Mac boot; no device timestamps.
mapping.uncertainty_note: 1 us numerical timestamp allowance only; not a bound on USB buffering or physical event time.

host.full_cycle_definition: Initial READY receipt inclusive to next READY receipt exclusive; includes READY/SLEEP host ACK holding, sleep, next boot, panel/radio preparation performed before next READY. Excludes final ordinary reset after last READY.
host.comparison_window_definition: Host SLEEP ACK flush completion +60 to +280 seconds; actual physical sleep entry and device sampling timestamps unknown.

meter_raw_proof.drop_accounting: No known device sequence counter; exact missing counts unknown. All detected gaps logged in events.jsonl.

nominal_10ms_per_received_sample.assumption: Exactly100Hz nominal device cadence; only received valid samples counted. Missing samples not invented; calibration/cadence error not bounded.

host_receipt_frame_mean_trapezoid.assumption: Trapezoid of frame-mean current/power at host receipt times; split at invalid frames or gaps>0.2s. No gap interpolation. Host buffering/timing may bias results.

integral_estimates.precision_claim: Approximate model estimates, not exact physical energy. No offset subtraction or missing-data compensation.

meter_raw_proof.raw_to_samples_proof: Every raw read reparsed with CRC; every decoded sample, zero, index, and timestamp matches JSONL exactly. Invalid raw frames produce no samples.

limitations: USB-input current/power of entire connected assembly; not RP2350 core current.
10 uA current resolution is not a verified calibration or absolute accuracy.
Four ordered samples per CRC frame share one actual receipt; individual device timestamps and sequence counter unknown.
Receipt gaps show host-visible delivery interruptions; cannot determine exact missing frames/samples or bound USB buffering delay.
All zero and high/low observations retained. No offset subtraction, clipping, smoothing, or energy compensation for missing data.
READY-to-READY includes variable host ACK delays. ACK flush completion does not prove instant device consumption.
Energy models are approximate; no exact physical energy or automatically steady current claim.
No median/percentiles accumulated: bounded memory moments only. Full raw evidence permits separate exact quantile analysis.
